summary: Kerb beside school sports ground, with cars parked and homes over 25 m away.

best_section.where: East kerb of Fairley Street along the school oval and grandstand

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto a school oval, sheds and a grandstand; the nearest dwellings are 26 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parking lane where cars are lined up.
drivers.traffic: School drop-off traffic on school days; quiet at night.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Steep: about 7% mean grade, up to 15% at points
No Stopping sign at the kerb line
sun_shade: Shaded by roadside trees from the east and north.
